record.title: TDS: COLLABORATION: The House of Bernarda Alba
record.summary: Tisch Drama Stage presents a production of Federico García Lorca's seminal play The House of Bernarda Alba, featuring a new translation by Caridad Svich and directed by Emily Mendelsohn. The play follows a family of five daughters in rural Spain locked into mourning for eight years after the death of their father.
